I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to weather data. For the most up‑to‑date forecast in London, you can check a reliable weather service such as:

- **BBC Weather** – https://www.bbc.com/weather/2643743  
- **Met Office** – https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/weather/forecast/ukw0802  
- **Weather.com** – https://weather.com/weather/today/l/London+United+Kingdom?canonicalCityId=...  

These sites will give you current conditions, hourly forecasts, and any weather alerts. If you’d like a quick summary of typical London weather (e.g., average temperatures, rainfall, etc.), let me know!
